bootstrap.draw: integers(0, n, size=(replicates, n), dtype=int64), one call, row r is replicate r

limitations: The percentile bootstrap is first-order approximate and assumes independent, exchangeable specimens
The signed RMA slope is discontinuous at zero covariance; intervals are unreliable when replicate slopes change sign
Endpoint bands describe Monte Carlo error at the declared replicate count, not sampling coverage
No measurement-error model; the comparison does not identify which measurement definition is correct
Marginal interval; make no joint claims with intervals from separate analyses
paired_summary.scope: Approximate first-order percentile interval for the paired slope difference; marginal. Inspection checks the saved replicates' internal consistency; only reproduction checks that they derive from the pairs and seed

export_scope: Single fits are complete native results; paired replicate arrays are exported as native CSV
